excludes: Submitted OpenAI SkillPilot Coach v1.0.0 and every effect covered by its active review freeze except the hash-pinned 2026-08-24 standard dual-provider WebGUI exception
Any allocation or implementation of Claude major line 2

candidate.definition: The connector candidate is the commit production runs when the listing is submitted; there is no frozen copy. The submission record names that commit and its build.
candidate.historicalContractBaseline: release/contract-baseline.json records the candidate captured on 2026-09-28 at revision 3ef222952264e9094602bd7cccef2c8feb9a8664. It is no freeze and is no longer compared with the repository; it stays byte-identical because the plugin candidate digest names it.

directoryIdentity.rule: The Directory slug is version-neutral and is never changed or treated as a protocol version.

majorLines.compatibilityPolicy: The Product Owner may still change the pre-submission v1 candidate. From submission on, the v1 line takes only backward-compatible fixes and additions, checked by the normal CI; a breaking change gets a new major line with its own endpoint. There is no submission freeze (Product Owner, 28 November 2026).
This endpoint is created only by a future Product Owner decision for a breaking protocol, identity, OAuth or state-semantics change.

breakingChangeProcess: Open a new major-line design and threat review without changing v1.
Use a separate DNS name, OAuth audience, secrets, test fixtures and acceptance evidence.
Run real-Claude acceptance, including the coach test through Claude's web interface, for the new major.
Keep v1 available during an explicit migration window.
Update Directory metadata and privacy statements through the Anthropic dashboard when the offered behavior changes.
Retire v1 only after documented migration, rollback and Product Owner approval.

anthropicCurrentBehavior.toolSurfaceUpdates: Anthropic currently says remote MCP tool changes are deployed to the live server without resubmission and are picked up on the next connection.
anthropicCurrentBehavior.semverDisclaimer: Anthropic does not define a SemVer or major-upgrade protocol for remote MCP connectors.
anthropicCurrentBehavior.slugRule: The Directory slug is permanent after publication.

Extended on 2026-09-17 to the binding concept § 6.5: learningPlanToday.text no longer contains the active-goal announcement; the connector publishes it separately as learningPlanToday.activeGoalAnnouncement, which the skill quotes once when teaching begins.
productOwnerContractChanges.classification: Pre-submission candidate change. The breaking-change process applies only after final submission freeze or publication, so major line 1 carries this change.
productOwnerContractChanges.consumerCoupling: Claude plugin skillpilot-coach-v1 1.1.7 is the first package whose instructions match this contract; deploy the connector and that package in one coordinated step.

productOwnerReleaseDecisions.scope: Remove release brakes that protect nothing for the Anthropic submission. The gates openai-review-freeze, openai-production-differential and mcp-inspector-all-fourteen-tools-two-resources are gone; claude-contract-tests, full-backend-suite and release-package-validation became ci-green-for-submitted-commit; rollback-drill and the load and latency part of load-latency-and-log-redaction are recommended, and log redaction moved to negative-and-replay-cases. The candidate is the commit production runs at submission, there is no submission freeze, and six server checks use the plugin record. The ChatGPT acceptance is no step before the Claude submission.
